source_tree_pin.scope: all regular files under app/src excluding test and androidTest, plus app/src/test/java/com/celzero/bravedns/ui/compose and app/src/test/resources; no unrelated test source
source_tree_pin.algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 concatenation of relative-path entries sorted lexicographically by their POSIX path-component tuples (Python PurePosixPath.parts ordering), each formatted as lowercase SHA-256, two ASCII spaces, POSIX relative path, LF
source_tree_pin.sort_order_clarification: This makes the existing generator ordering explicit; previous envelopes also used Python Path ordering, not whole-path string ordering.

conditions: Use only exact fully qualified class names in allowed_classes; no package wildcard or unfiltered Test task.
Fresh isolated local JVM process(es), plain android.app.Application for every Robolectric class; no device/instrumented execution or production RethinkDnsApplication construction/onCreate.

Do not mix with any unreviewed classes, existing production Koin graph, actual services, real database, account, credentials, tunnel, user traffic or persisted user data. The separately source-pinned host review must be revalidated independently before combining it.

Retain all current synthetic callbacks, constructor-free mocks, dispatchers, lifecycle bounds, empty/no-value paging fixtures, ordering and cleanup. Test/helper/production/dependency/launcher drift requires re-review.

UtilityContentTest may reach Logger.e -> VpnController.writeConsoleLog only with the initial null rvpn service. Logger state/Koin must be fresh; this is a null-safe no-op, never permission for a service or real database.
Use the exact reviewed Mockito and Byte Buddy startup-agent arguments in the opt-in launcher; no dynamic attach flags, OS/security/network changes, native application backend or unreviewed agent.

Visual output must be workspace-local. Unset rethink.visual.output and RETHINK_VISUAL_OUTPUT or set the effective value to an explicit directory beneath this task workspace; no user-data or external output path.

Robolectric native graphics, shadowed package/keyboard/window/clipboard/toast/accessibility operations and ordinary test reports/PNG/JSON/temp output are permitted within the isolated test workspace. No real export/permission/account/network operation is covered.
For the final additive run, use existing cached dependencies/offline mode only. This review does not authorize retrying a denied artifact-download destination.
not_covered: Package wildcard or arbitrary future tests
Production app startup, real Home or WireGuard host startup
Real VPN, firestack/Go backend, packet traffic, resolver, socket or URL requests
Passing results, complete coverage, functional parity or screenshot parity certification

additive_review.reason: Null-presenter synthetic SelectionContainer touch/key-copy tests; Robolectric-only clipboard seeded and cleared; method-scoped Magnifier.dismiss shadow. Shared dialog contrast changes are local color math and test JSON reporting.

reviewed_source_identity: frozen working-tree bytes identified by source_tree_pin and exact individual pins; coordinator snapshot pending

dns_lifecycle_delta_review.basis: Every reached description/flag/select/info/factory callback is an explicit test-memory lambda or SmartDnsContent local resource/string callback. The top-level bindDnsEndpointDescription helper selects supplied synthetic callbacks and data without constructing DnsEndpointPresenter or touching service/backend state. No production row factory, DB, DNS/IP lookup, service or account is constructed by the allowed classes.
fixture_correction_scope: Native Robolectric graphics and dialog attachment synchronization
Drain paused main while awaiting fake job results; observe completion
Process-local Robolectric instrumentation touch mode before generic Activity
No-op framework ViewModel.clear on constructor-free strict mocks only
Set existing generic test Activity theme for dialog resources
Two existing fake Event paging item-count waits bounded to 5000 ms with paused-main drain; exact order/cardinality assertions retained

replaced_method.reason: StandardTestDispatcher proves synchronous initial label rendering before fake IO work runs; flag remains lifecycle gated.

dns_bound_branch_delta_review.basis: The new top-level helper has no eager initialization and only branches over supplied booleans/callbacks/data. All new test callbacks record literals or throw assertion failures; no production presenter or service factory is used. Screen initialDescription is local Compose state; SmartDnsContent supplies local resource text and a null flag. Traffic paging waits drain only existing fake in-memory rows and keep exact assertions.
dns_bound_branch_delta_review.compiler_only_followup: Removed androidx.compose.ui.test.assertDoesNotExist import; all member-call assertions and method bodies unchanged.
